      Indicative layout
      Click any unit on the 3D model to view its official type and size and enter its status, price and notes.
      Click a block badge to open its block & stack grid. You can select many cells and update them at once.

      About this visualiser

      Thomson Reserve · Bright Hill Drive, District 20 · UOL & CapitaLand · 99-year leasehold.

      Layout & disclaimers

      • Tower footprints are from the official key plan; blocks, stacks, storeys, unit types and sizes are from the official elevation charts and unit-mix documents (1,268 units).
      • Building heights, storey heights and landscaping are indicative.
      • Satellite / Google imagery may predate construction of the development.
      • Unit status, prices and notes are entered by you and stored in this browser only.
      • Traffic is simulated (not live data); the noise layer is an indicative estimate from simulated traffic, not an acoustic assessment.
      • Surrounding buildings and roads: © OpenStreetMap contributors (heights partly estimated).

      Map credits

      Satellite imagery © Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics and the GIS User Community. Street / dark grey basemaps © Esri, HERE, Garmin, © OpenStreetMap contributors. Address points: OneMap (Singapore Land Authority). Google Maps data © Google when that mode is used.

      Google Maps (optional)

      Needs a Google Cloud project with billing, the Maps JavaScript API enabled and a vector Map ID with Tilt and Rotation. The key is stored in this browser only (localStorage). If the key has website restrictions, open this file through a local server and allow http://localhost/*; a double-clicked file:// page sends no referrer and is usually rejected.
